Game Overview

In Candy Love Rush, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Candy Love Rush's world of sweet delight. Match at least three candies to clear the board and rack up combos. Larger matches unleash special candies for massive impacts. With a simple tap, immersive graphics, and countless levels, it’s a treat for puzzle lovers of every age.
